mission: SQ-066 side-quest (operator-requested, HIGH PRIORITY): diagnose and fix the Google Search Console 'Unparsable structured data — Invalid top level element "string"' critical issue affecting ~40 pages of utilityexplained.com. Steps: (1) REPRODUCE locally — the rendered site is in public/ (fresh build): extract every <script type="application/ld+json"> block from affected page types (hubs like public/electricity-explained/index.html, category pages like public/blog/category/heating-cooling/index.html, core pages public/about/index.html, posts like public/blog/afue-vs-seer-vs-hspf-vs-cop/index.html) and validate each JSON block with python3 json.loads — find which blocks fail and WHY (the GSC error means a top-level JSON string instead of object/array, e.g. a template variable interpolating a bare quoted string). (2) LOCATE the emitting template — layouts/ partials/shortcodes (look for schema, jsonld, faq-schema, head/meta partials and how .Params values flow in; suspect: a string param injected where an object is expected, a Hugo variable printed with quotes around the whole block, or a shortcode emitting raw text). (3) FIX the template(s) so every rendered JSON-LD block parses as valid JSON (object or array at top level). (4) VERIFY: rebuild (hugo --gc --quiet), then re-extract and json.loads EVERY ld+json block in the whole public/ tree — zero parse failures required; quote the verification count. Note in your report: several GSC-listed URLs are retired aliases (41-how-to-read-electricity-bill, 02-average-utility-costs-2026, stormwater-fee-on-water-bill-explained, demand-charge-electricity-bill-explained, 7-states-with-worst-utility-spikes-2026, why-is-my-electricity-bill-so-high-in-summer/winter) — they redirect and will age out of GSC; focus on LIVE templates. Write the diagnosis + fix report to .squad/SQ-066/structured-data-fix.md.
parent_objective: SQ-066 remediation + operator-requested GSC structured-data fix
context: Site: Hugo v0.141.0 extended, layouts in layouts/, shortcodes in layouts/shortcodes/ (faq, faq-schema, visual, product-box, box, jump-row, affiliate-disclosure...), head partials under layouts/partials/ or layouts/_default/. The GSC error 'Invalid top level element string' = a JSON-LD script whose content parses to a bare JSON string (e.g. "some text") instead of {...} or [...] — classically caused by a Hugo template printing a string param as the whole block, or a stray quote/comma making the block a string. Compare WORKING pages' JSON-LD vs BROKEN ones to isolate the divergent template. Do NOT touch content/ files (another workstream owns them); your writes are layouts/** and the report file only.
